from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0036.png")
arr = np.array(img)

# Lets find the stool legs contact points in obs_0036
# Floor color is around [160, 155, 140] approx, stool legs are dark grey
print("Shape:", arr.shape)
# Crop around stool: u ~ 200..320, v ~ 300..450
crop = arr[300:450, 200:320]
# Find pixels that are dark (legs)
legs_mask = (crop[:, :, 0] < 80) & (crop[:, :, 1] < 80) & (crop[:, :, 2] < 80)
# Find lowest v for each leg cluster
import scipy.ndimage as ndi
lbl, n = ndi.label(legs_mask)
print(f"Found {n} leg components")
for i in range(1, n+1):
    pts = np.argwhere(lbl == i)
    # bottom point
    max_v = pts[:, 0].max() + 300
    mean_u = pts[pts[:, 0] == pts[:, 0].max(), 1].mean() + 200
    print(f"Leg {i}: u={mean_u:.1f}, v={max_v}")
'
